To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the grid connection for solar and wind converters can be modeled with the same tools as for electrical drives.

the grid-connected inverter can be modeled as a current controlled current source with a current controlled voltage source in parallel, which is connected in series to a current controlled voltage controlled current source.
the proposed control strategy can be used to control the grid current and the grid voltage in a wide range of operating conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following topics: Modeling grid connected converters for renewable energy systems Modeling and control of active and reactive grid current Modeling and simulation of grid synchronization and grid connection Modeling and analysis of grid connection and power flow Modeling and study of modulation strategies for grid connected converters Modeling of loss determination and thermal cycles Modeling and life time estimation of grid connected converters
all aspects of grid connection of solar and wind power converters.
the development of advanced simulation tools that can assist in the optimization of the grid connection of wind and solar energy converters, and the design of new control and modulation techniques.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
modeling of grid connected converters is a very important and interesting topic for simulation and research.
the modeling of grid connected converters is not only a matter of power electronic technology.

modeling of grid connected converters can only be performed by a complete system simulation tool, which includes all relevant components of a power system, such as generators, loads, grid, and power electronics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the simulation of the power electronics is the key to the simulation of grid connected converters, which are the key to the grid integration of solar and wind energy.

the simulation models can be used for the design and optimization of the power electronic converters, for the study of the impact of the grid connection and the control strategy on the power quality and the grid stability and for the study of grid connection issues for large scale wind and solar farms.
our research is focused on modeling of power electronics and control systems for grid connection and energy conversion of renewable energy.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the grid connection is a very important factor that must be considered when designing a grid connected solar and wind energy system, and the simulation of the grid connection must be done with great detail.
the grid connected converters can be designed to be as simple as possible.
the grid connection of renewable sources can be studied in great detail, and the impact on power quality and power system stability can be determined.
